title: catalog.json
description: Item types: real dimensions (metres) plus how to draw them: a core model (box, parts, glb, mat, roundRug) or a household builder (builders/*.py and .js next to rooms/). Catalogs merge in order: the engine's shared/catalog.json (generic entries), the household's catalog.json, the room's catalog.json; later entries win.

model.description: how to draw it: box, parts (primitives in `parts`), glb (a model `file`), mat / roundRug (flat rugs), or the name of a household or room builder (builders/<name>.py and .js)

texture.description: An image for a mat or rug (path in the room or household folder), e.g. one recovered with rug_from_scan.py.

kneeSpace.description: clear height under a table top (m), or "apron": for a table without drawers, just under its apron (`apron` deep, default 0.1, below a `top` thick top, default 0.04); chairs whose seatH fits under it may be pushed in

seatH.description: seat height (m); with a table's kneeSpace, lets a chair tuck under the table

group.description: pieces of one unit share a group: no clearance warnings between them

interiorLight.description: A lamp inside the item (a lit cabinet's or an enclosure's), on with the lamps unless the scene switches the item off; hidden from the camera. Defaults 800 lm, 2700 K (assumed).

lumens.description: Light output in lumens (the bulb's or fixture's rated output).

kelvin.description: Colour temperature (K); default: the room's lights.kelvin, else 2700 (assumed).

z.description: height of the light above the floor (m)

light.description: The item's light, in real units (tools/photometry.py): without it the builder's default is used and listed as ASSUMED.

lumens.description: Total for the item (all its bulbs), e.g. about 800 for one 60 W-equivalent LED bulb.

kelvin.description: Colour temperature (K); default: the room's lights.kelvin, else 2700 (assumed).

dimToWarm.description: [kelvin at full, kelvin at the bottom] for a dim-to-warm bulb, e.g. [2700, 2200].

dimCurve.description: How a dimmer setting maps to light output: square (most wall and plug-in dimmers, default: 20% gives 4%), linear, log (DALI).

beam.description: Full beam angle (degrees) for builders with spot lights.

layer.description: Which switch the item's light follows: lamp (default; the scene's lamps) or ceiling (pendants, chandeliers, flush lights, panels, tube lights, fan lights; the scene's ceiling setting).

hang.description: hangs from the ceiling (a pendant, a ceiling fan): without its own `ceiling`, the item's top sits at the room's ceiling height over it

parts.description: model parts: the primitives that draw the item (docs/MODELING.md)

materials.description: model parts: named materials the parts use

kind.description: default paint; shade = translucent fabric lampshade, glow = lit paper (on with the lamps)

file.description: model glb: the model file, relative to the room folder or the household folder (e.g. models/chair.glb)

fit.description: model glb: scale uniformly to fit inside w x d x h (default), stretch each axis to it, or keep the file's size

rotate.description: model glb: degrees about x, y, z applied before fitting (turn the front to -y, stand it up)

partsSize.description: model parts: the w, d, h the parts were drawn at (default: the catalog entry's); an item resized in a layout stretches to its own w, d, h

part.description: One primitive of a `parts` model, in item-local metres: x to the right as you face the item's front, y toward its back, z up, origin at the footprint centre on the floor.

at.description: centre (box, cylinder, cone, sphere) or base point (lathe, extrude)

axis.description: cylinder or cone axis (default z, upright)

scale.description: sphere: stretch along x, y, z (an ellipsoid: a cushion, a pouf, a canopy)

profile.description: lathe: [radius, height] pairs from the bottom up, turned about the vertical axis (legs, vases, lamp bases)

points.description: extrude: a plan outline [[x, y], ...] around `at`, extruded up by h (shaped tops, seats)

rot.description: degrees about x, then y, then z

mirror.description: also draw the part mirrored across the item's centre line(s): four legs from one

material.description: a name in the item's `materials`, or "#rrggbb"; default: the item's color

role.description: what the part is for other tools, e.g. "shade" (the part a lamp's light sits in)

open.description: cylinder, cone, lathe: leave the ends open (a lampshade, a tube)
